conversation.content: I'm putting together a degree plan; start it with the program the student is pursuing: Bachelor of Arts in Psychology.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan", "value": {"program_name": "Bachelor of Arts in Psychology"}}]
This degree needs 120 credits for graduation.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/required_credits", "value": 120}]
The student has already completed 72 credits toward the degree.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/earned_credits", "value": 72}]
Plan on the student taking 12 credits each term from here on.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/planned_credits_per_term", "value": 12}]
Also note that, based on those numbers, the student still has 48 credits to finish.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/remaining_credits", "value": 48}]
Since that works out to four more terms at the planned pace, mark the student as still on pace to finish.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/on_track", "value": true}]
Show that, at 12 credits per term, finishing the remaining work will take four more terms.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/projected_terms_to_completion", "value": 4}]
Add the academic advisor for this plan: Dr. Lena Ortiz.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/advisor_name", "value": "Dr. Lena Ortiz"}]
Include that this plan follows the 2024–2025 catalog.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/catalog_year", "value": "2024–2025"}]
Add one final note that the student’s concentration is child and adolescent development.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree_plan/concentration", "value": "Child and Adolescent Development"}]

edit_instruction: Update the degree so it requires 132 total credits to graduate.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a degree plan with a credit requirement and credits earned, where a remaining-to-requirement, an on-track flag, and a projected completion derive from the requirement, the earned credits, and a stated per-term load. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a degree plan would carry that do not depend on the credit requirement, and vary their number from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change the degree's required total credits to a specific new number.
cascade_pattern: Editing the requirement re-derives the remaining-to-requirement, re-evaluates the on-track flag, and re-derives the projected completion from the remaining and the stated per-term load. The earned credits and per-term load stay. This is determined because the per-term load and earned credits are stated.
